import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartRestrictedFibre
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling

/-!
Does the TWO-OPEN ("separable") assembly weaken the obligation?

`hf` is ANTITONE in V (smaller V is easier); the coverage containment is MONOTONE in V
(larger V is easier).  The split assembly demands `hf` at the LARGER open `Vf` and the
containment at the SMALLER open `Vc`, i.e. each at its HARD end.  So the split is not a
relaxation, and this file measures the exact relationship.
-/

universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable section

/-- Coverage containment, as a predicate on the confining family. -/
def Confined {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) (V : ∀ i, (X i).Opens) : Prop :=
  ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (s : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op T)) (t : ↥T),
    ∃ (W : T.Opens) (_ : t ∈ W) (i : ι) (x : (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ X i),
      (f i).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) x = (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.map (W.ι).op s ∧
        Set.range (x.base) ⊆ Set.range ((V i).ι.base)

theorem hf_antitone {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
    {U V : X.Opens} (e : U ≤ V) (h : IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (restrictChart f V)) :
    IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (restrictChart f U) := by
  have hcomp : restrictChart f U = yoneda.map (X.homOfLE e) ≫ restrictChart f V := by
    rw [restrictChart, restrictChart, ← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, Scheme.homOfLE_ι]
  rw [hcomp]
  exact MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderComposition.comp_mem _ _
    (isOpenImmersion_presheaf_yoneda_map _) h

theorem confined_monotone {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) {Vc Vf : ∀ i, (X i).Opens}
    (hle : ∀ i, Vc i ≤ Vf i) (h : Confined C f Vc) : Confined C f Vf := by
  intro T s t
  obtain ⟨W, htW, i, x, hx, hrange⟩ := h T s t
  refine ⟨W, htW, i, x, hx, hrange.trans ?_⟩
  have he : (Vc i).ι = (X i).homOfLE (hle i) ≫ (Vf i).ι := (Scheme.homOfLE_ι _ _).symm
  rw [he]
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hz
  exact ⟨((X i).homOfLE (hle i)).base w, rfl⟩

/-! ## The collapse: the two-open assembly is EQUIVALENT to the one-open one -/

/-- **A split solution collapses to a shared-`V` solution, at `Vc`.**  So the two-open
assembly grants no freedom the shared-`V` question did not already have. -/
theorem shared_of_split {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) (Vf Vc : ∀ i, (X i).Opens)
    (hle : ∀ i, Vc i ≤ Vf i)
    (huniv : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (restrictChart (f i) (Vf i)))
    (hcov : Confined C f Vc) :
    (∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (restrictChart (f i) (Vc i))) ∧ Confined C f Vc :=
  ⟨fun i => hf_antitone (f i) (hle i) (huniv i), hcov⟩

/-- **And a shared-`V` solution is a split solution**, with `Vf = Vc`.  Together with
`shared_of_split` the two satisfiability questions are the SAME question. -/
theorem split_of_shared {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) (V : ∀ i, (X i).Opens)
    (huniv : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (restrictChart (f i) (V i)))
    (hcov : Confined C f V) :
    ∃ Vf Vc : ∀ i, (X i).Opens, (∀ i, Vc i ≤ Vf i) ∧
      (∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (restrictChart (f i) (Vf i))) ∧ Confined C f Vc :=
  ⟨V, V, fun _ => le_refl _, huniv, hcov⟩

/-- **A split solution ALSO gives the shared solution at the larger open `Vf`.**  Both ends of
the nesting are shared solutions, which is the sharpest form of the collapse. -/
theorem shared_top_of_split {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) (Vf Vc : ∀ i, (X i).Opens)
    (hle : ∀ i, Vc i ≤ Vf i)
    (huniv : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (restrictChart (f i) (Vf i)))
    (hcov : Confined C f Vc) :
    (∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (restrictChart (f i) (Vf i))) ∧ Confined C f Vf :=
  ⟨huniv, confined_monotone C f hle hcov⟩

end
end AlgebraicGeometry

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartRestrictedFibre
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling

/-!
p1's gap in my collapse argument (I-1068): my ProbeCollapse used the CONTAINMENT spelling.
The seam consumes an `IsLocallySurjective` INSTANCE on `Sigma.desc`. Is THAT binder monotone
in `V`?  If yes, the collapse holds at the instance level and the nesting genuinely buys
nothing.  If no, the collapse is only about the hcov spelling.

The point: `restrictChart (f i) (Vc i)` factors through `restrictChart (f i) (Vf i)` when
`Vc i ≤ Vf i`, so `Sigma.desc` of the smaller family factors through `Sigma.desc` of the
larger — and local surjectivity of a composite through a map gives it for the second factor.
-/

universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}

noncomputable section

/-- `Sigma.desc` of the smaller restricted family factors through that of the larger one. -/
theorem sigmaDesc_restrictChart_factor {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) {Vc Vf : ∀ i, (X i).Opens}
    (hle : ∀ i, Vc i ≤ Vf i) :
    Sigma.desc (fun i => restrictChart (f i) (Vc i))
      = (Sigma.map (fun i => yoneda.map ((X i).homOfLE (hle i))))
        ≫ Sigma.desc (fun i => restrictChart (f i) (Vf i)) := by
  ext i
  simp only [colimit.ι_desc, Cofan.mk_ι_app, Sigma.ι_comp_map_assoc,
    Category.assoc, colimit.ι_desc_assoc]
  rw [restrictChart, restrictChart, ← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, Scheme.homOfLE_ι]

/-- **THE INSTANCE BINDER IS MONOTONE IN `V`.**  Local surjectivity at the smaller family
gives it at the larger one, because the smaller `Sigma.desc` factors through the larger. -/
theorem isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_mono {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) {Vc Vf : ∀ i, (X i).Opens}
    (hle : ∀ i, Vc i ≤ Vf i)
    (h : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology
      (Sigma.desc (fun i => restrictChart (f i) (Vc i)))) :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology
      (Sigma.desc (fun i => restrictChart (f i) (Vf i))) := by
  rw [sigmaDesc_restrictChart_factor f hle] at h
  exact Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_of_isLocallySurjective_fac
    (Category.comp_id _) (g := Sigma.desc (fun i => restrictChart (f i) (Vf i))) h

end
end AlgebraicGeometry
